description: SaaS platform compatibility contract. The platform is the hub: every known consumer module is declared here. The ContractTest reads each module's composer.json require (nreljed/platform caret ^1.0 range) and asserts the CURRENT platform release (composer.json version) satisfies it — so a platform minor bump must land simultaneously with the modules updating their ranges. Modules run the reverse guard in their own ModuleCoreCompatibilityTest (installed platform must satisfy their declared constraint).
